name: Kousaka Michiru
source: One of the characters of the Correctness storyline. He is an official at the Ministry of International Trade and Industry. Seemingly, he has not changed much aside from becoming more reserved and evasive. [spoiler]A Frontier party supporter, he is responsible for a substantial portion of the events that have transpired in the ward, primarily through acting as a match maker and orchestrating encounters between certain characters.[/spoiler]
